title: EXIT VELOCITY // 2099
description: 140 BPM F minor. A lowrider whistle and talking bass turn an asymmetric two-bar signal into a late-night payoff.

tracks.description: Short low punch; first transient has priority over the delayed sub.
Late halftime clap; occasional ghost slaps mark four-bar turns.
Humanized eighths, selected gaps and a few short rolls.
Dry, syncopated rim answers: a nod to West Coast bounce.
Sparse metallic punctuation on phrase boundaries.
Clean, gated F1 bass foundation; leaves a pocket for kick.
Vowel-swept F2 bass; punctuates the kick, not constant wobble.
Bent F5 whistle motif announced at frame zero.
Warm midrange response in the gaps, not a unison lead layer.
Wide, sparse 7th chords supply skyline without masking the bass.
Short falling motor gesture announces section turns.
Distinct right-side midrange counterphrase opens the payoff without widening the low end.
